The waw-clause I have made it for myself: the suffix on עֲשִׂיתִנִי is 1cs and is realized by for myself, so the English it supplies an object no morpheme writes and is added under rule 44.

My river is mine own divides the copula onto the possessive לְ (rule 49) and the whole emphatic possessive mine own onto its suffix (rule 18); תַּנִּים takes only monster here, since the ASV writes no specifier sea (contrast rule 31's sea monsters).
